description: An Advisory sent when a Stream snapshot is created
title: io.nats.jetstream.advisory.v1.snapshot_create

id.description: Unique correlation ID for this event

timestamp.description: The time this event was created in RFC3339 format

stream.description: The name of the Stream being snapshotted

blocks.description: Approximate number of blocks in the snapshot

block_size.description: The size, in bytes, of every block

client.description: Details about the client that connected to the server

host.description: The remote host the client is connected from

id.description: The internally assigned client ID for this connection

acc.description: The account this user logged in to

svc.description: The service account for the user

name.description: The name presented by the client during connection

lang.description: The programming language library in use by the client

ver.description: The version of the client library in use

rtt.description: The last known latency between the NATS Server and the Client in nanoseconds

server.description: The server that the client was connected to

cluster.description: The cluster name the server is connected to

items.description: List of alternative clusters that can be used as overflow for resource placement, in RTT order

jwt.description: The JWT presented in the connection

issuer_key.description: The public signing key or account identity key used to issue the user

name_tag.description: The name extracted from the user JWT claim

kind.description: The kind of client. Can be Client/Leafnode/Router/Gateway/JetStream/Account/System

client_type.description: The type of client. When kind is Client, this contains the type: mqtt/websocket/nats

nonce.description: The NONCE that was presented to the client during initial INFO

reply.description: Original reply subject after a service import, only set when needed

state.description: The state of the Stream at the time the snapshot was started

messages.description: Number of messages stored in the Stream

bytes.description: Combined size of all messages in the Stream

first_seq.description: Sequence number of the first message in the Stream

first_ts.description: The timestamp of the first message in the Stream
first_ts.$comment: A point in time in RFC3339 format including timezone, though typically in UTC

last_seq.description: Sequence number of the last message in the Stream

last_ts.description: The timestamp of the last message in the Stream
last_ts.$comment: A point in time in RFC3339 format including timezone, though typically in UTC

deleted.description: IDs of messages that were deleted using the Message Delete API or Interest based streams removing messages out of order

subjects.description: Subjects and their message counts when a subjects_filter was set

num_subjects.description: The number of unique subjects held in the stream
num_subjects.$comment: integer with a dynamic bit size depending on the platform the cluster runs on, can be up to 64bit

num_deleted.$comment: integer with a dynamic bit size depending on the platform the cluster runs on, can be up to 64bit

lost.description: Records messages that were damaged and unrecoverable

bytes.description: The number of bytes that were lost

consumer_count.description: Number of Consumers attached to the Stream
consumer_count.$comment: integer with a dynamic bit size depending on the platform the cluster runs on, can be up to 64bit

domain.description: The domain of the JetStream server the event is from
